authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Current Planning Data Local authority district dataset contains England administrative boundary polygons supplied for statistics, with 344 district records. Up to 50 records were considered as the bounded source window. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LAD/LPA identifier or name, local-plan/local-plan-boundary reference, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Therefore no district polygon can be bound to this slot without guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
